crossRefs.note: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

translations.web: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”
translations.bsb: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.”
translations.kjv: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
translations.asv: And other money have we brought down in our hand to buy food: we know not who put our money in our sacks.
